Select approved drugs with mechanism of action action_type INHIBITOR. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism and target_dictionary. Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals INHIBITOR. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and target_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, target_name.
